pack_name: 越南默认 Market Pack V1（围巾试点）

visual_rules.photographic_style: realistic smartphone photo, natural handheld framing, no studio backdrop look
climate_constraints: hot and humid most of the year; scarves are styled as an accent, never as proof of warmth
heavy winter outerwear only for travel, air-conditioned venues or explicit seasonal themes
northern cool season (Hanoi winter) may show light layering with a scarf
visual_rules.color_grading: warm natural daylight, consistent tone across the 5-shot group
visual_rules.scarf_visibility: the specified scarf must stay clearly readable; it may cover the neck and part of the chest but never the face

copy_rules.fallback_note: unsupported market/language combos must fail loudly, never silently fall back to Thai or English
copy_rules.style: casual friendly Vietnamese as used by local young women on TikTok, avoid formal written Vietnamese and machine-translated wording
copy_rules.review_requirement: every Vietnamese template actually used in production must reach NATIVE_APPROVED; DRAFT is allowed during development but blocks publishing

topic_rules._destination_weight_note: 相对抽样权重，键与 recipe variables_schema.destination 及 Locale Pack labels.destinations 一致。首批 12 篇的具体家族分配另见规格 §10；Tokyo/Shanghai 等 cool_city 不得默认生成雪景（由 Destination Catalog 的 snow_scene_policy 决定）。
topic_rules._destination_weight_pending: 权重为开发期初值，待运营按目的地家族确认后调整。
topic_rules._content_family_weight_note: 首批 12 篇的两线配比（围巾日常搭配 5 / 围巾旅行穿搭 7），用于验证能力，不是长期固定比例。
topic_rules._posting_window_pending: 发布时段为开发期默认值，待运营按越南本地数据确认。
topic_rules.topic_frequency_rule: avoid repeating the same topic_text within 7 days on one account
topic_rules._travel_theme_note: 温度只作为整套服装语境，不允许声称单条围巾保证保暖（规格 §5.2）。

banned: claims that a single scarf guarantees warmth
safety_rules.face_visibility: face must stay natural and unobscured; the scarf may not cover the face or distort the head-shoulder proportion
safety_rules.background_music: never burn licensed BGM into the master when platform_hot_bgm is planned
